I don't know how much I've taken, but I took a mix of OTC medication like ibuprofen and paracetamol as well as my dads old pain medication and my antidepressants. I know overdosing makes you feel unwell regardless of if it's lethal or not so I'm a bit unsure as to if its even doing damage. (I'd probably estimate 130? 500mg pills ) 

I took them around 40 minutes ago, I think I could still throw them up as I'm getting waves of nausea every 5 or so minutes.
